name: sheep-shear
comment: WP-2.3 task 1. A 16x16 stone platform y = 60 over chunk (0,0) fenced at y = 61 (id 85, 1.5 high); the player (id 0) stands outside on a stone pad at (7.5, 61, -2.5), out of the sheep's 8-block look range, and three sheep (ids 1-3, white: the constructor does not colour a sheep, only SpawnerAnimals draws EntitySheep.getRandomFleeceColor) in the pen. The interact op puts its item_id into hotbar slot currentItem first and leaves the slot as it is without one. t=5 interact on sheep 1 with shears (359): EntitySheep.interact (EntitySheep.java:34-53) sets the sheared bit, drops 2 + rand.nextInt(3) wool blocks (Block.cloth, damage = colour) 1 block up through entityDropItem, each nudged by three rand draws, and damages the shears (damage 1); it returns false, so useCurrentItemOnEntity tries ItemStack.useItemOnEntity (Item.saddleEntity: nothing). t=8 the same shears on the sheared sheep: nothing, no damage. t=12 the shears on sheep 2 (damage 2). t=25 save (Tier S): chunk (0,0) NBT with the sheep's Sheared/Color (EntitySheep.java:55-59) and the wool items. t=40 a hit of 20 kills the sheared sheep 1 (EntitySheep.dropFewItems: nothing), t=45 kills sheep 3 (one white wool, no rand draw). The player is 10 blocks from the drops and never reaches them (its item pickup is EntityPlayer.onLivingUpdate, WP-2.5). rng_state and entity_state every tick.
